newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Motorola in Singapore cable modem trials.
newsitem.headline: Motorola in Singapore cable modem trials.

text.p: Motorola Inc. said on Tuesday it had signed a contract to supply high-speed cable modems for market trials of the Singapore ONE multimedia project just launched by Prime Minister Goh Cok Tong.

Dick Day, general manager of the Motorola Multimedia Group said the company had signed a deal to supply 2,100 cable modems to Singapore Cablevision Ltd (SCV) for its public trials of the system to provide high-speed Internet access
"Cable modem is a paradigm shift for any Internet user used to a dial-up modem. It changes the entire Internet experience. The information is almost instantly available," Day told a news conference.
Trials of the system, enabling fast downloading of video clips, video conferencing, full interactivity and Internet transactions, are expected to run until mid-1998.
The two-way multimedia cable modem allows continous connection to the Internet without tying up the line while ensuring users pay only for data transmission or receipt.
Singapore ONE is a national broadband multimedia network initiative aimed at transforming Singapore into an intelligent island.
SCV has a Singapore $500 million investment programme in progress to connect every home on the island to the broadband network.
